title: deschampsia aurea
intro: Deschampsia aurea, commonly known as golden hair grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to support respiratory health and is valued for its potential to soothe bronchial irritation and relieve coughs. The health benefits of Deschampsia aurea include its ability to help reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties.
